integrated_answer.basis: CHATWOOT_AGENT_POLICY_V1. Coordinator independently checked immutable source supporting retained worker findings. SOURCE_OBSERVED describes code/spec assertions; the matrix is INFERRED_FROM_SOURCE regression design, not executed behavior.

interactions.claim: Controller prioritizes AgentBot pending+explicit open handoff, then present-status assignment/save!, otherwise model toggle/save. Resulting-open User requests also run locked human handling. Model toggles open->resolved and every other enum state->open; before_save clears snooze unless final state snoozed.

Response emits success=@status, conversation display_id, current_status and snoozed_until. Ordinary save branches set @status; handoff branch does not. Handoff null success is an inference requiring characterization, not a reproduced defect.
